title: Credit committed-input test evidence by claim and exact commit, without a named root or root sighting
outcome: Credit committed-input test evidence by claim and exact commit, without a named root or root sighting
acceptance: A registered or remote verification whose input is a committed input (exact commit with equal before/after source_id) is credited to the claimed item's run by claim, fence and run plus that commit/source_id, without requiring a bound named root on the claim or a named-root sighting

Independent acceptance evaluation of an item whose cited evidence is all committed-input evidence no longer requires a named source root or a named-root sighting (no named_root_sighting_required or no-naming-history refusal for that case)

Obligations from source changes are closed by committed-input evidence whose source_id equals the observed change's source_id, with the matching rule documented; uncommitted (working-tree) observation keeps its named-root requirements unchanged
Every refusal on these paths names the deciding check, the observed and expected values and a remedy
docs/features/execution-observability.md and acceptance-evaluation docs describe the committed-input rule; a design review with Engram::Fable and a read-only Codex explorer is recorded before coding
disposal_reason: Superseded before any work: Kimi::Consultant's final joint design (c15db92c #210, 19:30:39Z) keeps Engram's named-root, revision, claim and fence guards; TermAl's builder names the root inside the host operation and re-delivers the same terminal origin with the current binding when a delivery goes stale. No Engram evidence or wire change is needed for workRef + branch.
